newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile cement firm to carry out copper exploration.
newsitem.headline: Chile cement firm to carry out copper exploration.

text.p: Chilean cement company Cementos Bio Bio said it will sign a deal with copper mining firm Mantos Blancos to carry out exploration for copper on Mantos' properties which could result in a joint mining venture.
"In the event that a deposit can be exploited commercially, then we may form an association with Mantos Blancos," said the statement to the Securities Superintendency.
Cementos Bio Bio has set up a new unit to be called Compania Minera Mantos Bio Bio to prospect on the land, it said.
Mantos, which operates two medium-sized mines in Chile, is 75-percent owned by Luxembourg-based Minorco.
